measurement: Fresh null-parent session cumulative telemetry, one session counted once
subsetRule: cached_input_tokens are included in input_tokens; reasoning_output_tokens are included in output_tokens. Neither is added twice.
coordinatorOrchestrationTokens: unknown; external parent is outside this worker session
unmeasuredTail: Later publishing, verification and final reporting requests plus opaque platform overhead are not included in this cutoff. Counts are not monetary charges.
